tasks.short: Advise students on curricula and career issues

steps.what: Clarify the student's actual academic interests, circumstances and career questions
inputs: student's actual interests, circumstances and questions

steps.what: Look up the actual curriculum requirements, course options and relevant existing career-service information
inputs: teacher-understood advising needs
current institution-issued curriculum and course information
existing career-service material

steps.what: Advise the student directly on academic or vocational curriculum choices and career issues, explaining uncertainty and available support
inputs: teacher-understood advising needs
teacher-checked relevant options and requirements
student's actual follow-up questions
outputs: actual student-specific advice and questions addressed

tasks.design: Configure native curriculum links in {OPS_SYSTEM} and indexed career-service information in {DOCS}. The teacher checks actual requirements and advises the student directly; no model selects a career or promises eligibility or employment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant course requirements and career-service sources can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue links and indexed documents can expose the actual approved sources.
tasks.still_hard: Understand the student's priorities and explain realistic tradeoffs.
tasks.human_edge: Give contextual advice without reducing the student to a profile.

ambition.what: Improve source access for direct advising.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: academic advisers consult curriculum requirements and course/career resources; native source links can reduce navigation while personal advice remains human.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the institution's curriculum/course catalogue. Curriculum and career-service owners produce source information; teacher clarifies actual needs in s1. No new structured student profile is assumed.

Native links first. Scenario is direct advising, not a written recommendation or enrollment transaction. No record is silently bundled into the conversation; if actual advice is written or a local advising entry is required, map its authoring and gated send/save rather than exclude it.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 2 minus 0.3 link upkeep gives 1.7 net. No recurring office-hour preparation baseline is added.
unknowns: Current source navigation and actual written-advice or advising-record requirements
research_questions: Observe an actual advising case and identify source lookup, direct advice and any real written response separately.

already_counted.description: Check actual curriculum and career-service sources

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if existing catalogue access already sufficient; cautious range below provisional 1.7% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship and research work

steps.what: Read the actual student's research work and evaluate its question, sources, argument and progress against agreed objectives
inputs: actual student research submission
agreed project objectives and source requirements
outputs: teacher's actual supervision assessment and source-specific concerns

steps.what: Discuss actual research decisions, difficulties and next steps with the student
inputs: teacher's actual supervision assessment and source-specific concerns
student's actual questions and account
outputs: actual supervision feedback and agreed research next steps

steps.what: Write and check substantive marginal comments and agreed next steps in the student's existing shared work
inputs: teacher's actual supervision assessment and source-specific concerns
actual supervision feedback and agreed research next steps

steps.what: Save the checked supervision annotations in the existing shared document
inputs: complete checked source-specific supervision annotations

tasks.design: Retain substantive research supervision and annotations in {DOCS}, linked through the existing {LMS}. Native shared commenting already supports the actual written feedback in this scenario; generic comment templates do not replace source-specific scholarly judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision concerns the student's actual argument and research decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared document comments support feedback but establish no additional reduction.
tasks.still_hard: Recognize conceptual problems and guide independent scholarship.
tasks.human_edge: Develop the student's reasoning without taking over their work.

ambition.what: Keep substantive supervision with the teacher.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: research supervision combines reading actual work, discussion and substantive annotations; existing shared comments do not resolve scholarly judgement.

assumptions: Concrete scenario is research supervision, one population in the statement; teaching and internship supervision require their actual observation/work products. Student produces the work, teacher produces actual assessment and feedback.
Source review, conversation, written annotations and save are explicitly split. Native shared comments already available. No new meeting report or self-approval ceremony is added.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios; all work retained, gross and net zero. Same-system save is 1% fully retained.
unknowns: Actual supervision mode and whether any feedback is duplicated into a separate record
research_questions: Observe actual supervision annotations and any separate progress record before estimating duplicate entry.

already_counted.description: Author and check actual source-specific annotations

approvals.approved_version: complete supervision annotations checked at end of s3; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual reading, feedback and existing native annotations retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain textbooks, materials and supplies

steps.what: Identify actual course needs, existing holdings, accessibility requirements and purchasing constraints
inputs: actual course requirements and existing holdings
approved purchasing constraints and available budget
outputs: teacher-checked material requirements and purchase limits

steps.what: Find actual available textbook editions or supplies and check catalogue terms and availability
inputs: teacher-checked material requirements and purchase limits
actual library/supplier catalogues
outputs: source-checked available materials, editions and terms

steps.what: Select the actual material for curricular fit, translation/edition quality and practical access
inputs: source-checked available materials, editions and terms
teacher-checked material requirements and purchase limits

steps.what: Prepare and finish checking the exact authorized order, edition identifiers, quantities, terms and destination
inputs: teacher-selected exact materials and quantities
teacher-checked material requirements and purchase limits
existing verified institutional delivery/account fields
outputs: complete checked authorized material order and supplier destination, or hold

steps.what: Submit the exact checked order within actual purchasing authority
inputs: complete checked authorized material order and supplier destination, or hold
outputs: actual submitted material order and receipt, or retained hold

steps.what: Check actual received materials or digital access against the selected order and identify discrepancies
inputs: actual submitted material order and receipt, or retained hold
actual delivered materials or provided digital access
outputs: actual receipt/access checked and discrepancies identified

tasks.design: Use native catalogue filters and saved institutional fields in {PROCUREMENT}, with actual library/supplier records in {OTHER}. The teacher chooses curricular content and checks the exact authorized order before submission, then verifies actual receipt or access.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct edition and repeating institutional order fields can add search and entry work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue filters and existing account fields can reduce repeated navigation and entry.
tasks.still_hard: Choose a suitable translation or edition and verify accessibility and teaching fit.
tasks.human_edge: Judge materials against the actual course rather than catalogue similarity.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated catalogue and order-field work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native procurement/catalogue tools filter editions and reuse institutional account fields; teachers still select curricular materials and verify receipt.

assumptions: OTHER is the actual library/supplier catalogue. Supplier/library records produce availability and edition information; teacher supplies requirements and selections in s1/s3. No invented catalogue, price or product.

Native filters/account fields first. Scenario has delegated authority for this order; absent authority holds submission for the actual purchasing process, without assumed approval. Receipt is actual delivered material or working access, not an order-status inference.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 6.9 minus 0.8 filter/account upkeep gives 6.1 net. The short order send is 1% fully retained; no delivery-time or supplier-labor saving.
unknowns: Actual purchasing authority, catalogue coverage and repeated order fields
research_questions: Which searches and account fields are actually repeated, and who has authority for the final order?

already_counted.description: Check catalogue results and exact order

incremental.description: Maintain catalogue filters and saved institutional fields

approvals.approved_version: complete authorized order, edition/quantity, terms and supplier destination checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if native search/account fields already adequate; cautious range below provisional 6.1% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate with colleagues on teaching and research issues

steps.what: Review the actual teaching or research issue and relevant shared source material
inputs: actual issue raised by colleagues
actual relevant teaching or research documents
outputs: teacher's source-checked understanding of the issue

steps.what: Discuss alternatives with colleagues and agree how to address the actual issue
inputs: teacher's source-checked understanding of the issue
colleagues' actual evidence and proposals
outputs: actual agreed clarification or revision for the shared work

steps.what: Revise and check the teacher's actual agreed clarification in the shared assignment or research document
inputs: actual agreed clarification or revision for the shared work
actual relevant teaching or research documents

steps.what: Save the checked contribution in the existing shared document
inputs: complete checked substantive shared-document revision

tasks.design: Retain actual issue review, discussion and the agreed substantive revision in {DOCS}. Native shared editing already supports the contribution; a meeting-note generator does not resolve the teaching or research issue.
tasks.previous_blocker: The issue needs colleagues' evidence and scholarly or pedagogical judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared documents support revision but establish no additional repeatable reduction.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve differing interpretations and choose a workable change.
tasks.human_edge: Reason with colleagues and own the contribution.

ambition.what: Keep substantive collaboration with the colleagues involved.

reach.task: Contribute actual evidence and evaluate the shared issue
reach.learn: The actual proposed clarification and its implications

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: teaching and research collaboration may produce substantive shared-document changes; existing shared editing does not perform the underlying judgement.

assumptions: Concrete scenario is collaboration resulting in an actual assignment clarification or research-document revision. This is substantive work, not an invented meeting report. Colleagues produce actual evidence; teacher authors only their own contribution.
Source review, conversation, document revision and save are explicitly split. Native shared editing already available; no duplicated note, formal self-approval layer or unmodeled document send.

Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. All work retained, gross and net zero. Any identical revision counted in another task must be owned once in synthesis; no fake shared-step identifier is assigned.
unknowns: Actual issue outcome and any duplicated entry beyond the shared contribution
research_questions: Observe one actual collaborative revision and identify genuine duplicate work separately from substantive editing.

already_counted.description: Write and check actual substantive shared revision

approvals.approved_version: complete actual contribution checked at end of s3; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual source review, discussion and substantive shared editing retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Curriculum and procurement owners supply actual source information and purchasing authority; colleagues retain scholarly judgement.
skills_to_grow: Check current curriculum and edition details
Separate actual annotations from duplicate reports
Verify exact order payloads within real authority
